name: empire-at-war-browser-edition
description: Empire at War: Browser Edition - Star Wars: Empire at War and Forces of Corruption in the browser, running on your own copy of the game

scripts.deploy:prod: node tools/build.mjs && cd lobby && npx wrangler deploy --env production && npx wrangler pages deploy ../dist --project-name empire-at-war-browser-edition --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.wasm: asc wasm/pathsearch.ts -o public/js/game/pathsearch.wasm -O3 --runtime stub --noAssert --initialMemory 32 && asc wasm/landpose.ts -o public/js/game/landpose.wasm -O3 --runtime stub --noAssert --initialMemory 2 --enable simd
